'''Donal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the first [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]] began and the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] was [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|emptied]], Donal met up with the woman named [[Fy-Tor-Ana|Solace]]. Solace, who in reality was former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Fy-Tor-Ana, was forming a [[Solace (location)|resistance group]] in the planet's crust. Donal became Solace's personal assistant.<ref name="l3" />

When Solace agreed to accompany former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] to the Jedi Temple in an effort to prevent [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] from discovering the underground settlement, Donal stayed behind to look after the [[Erased]] who had travelled to the place of Solace, including [[Keets Freely]], [[Oryon]], [[Curran Caladian]], [[Rhya Taloon|Ryha Taloon]], [[Hume (officer)|Hume]], [[Gilly]] and [[Spence]].<ref name="l3" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If I hadn't been away, I could've gotten them all out. I had a plan... but they had a spy. It was Duro. My trusted assistant. It had to be. They got to him - offered him money, threatened him - and he agreed to betray us. He was the only one except me who knew about the warning system. He must have turned it off."<br>"I'm afraid you're right. I saw Duro being given a speeder to escape in.|Solace and Oryon|<ref name="l4">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>}}
Donal first appeared in the [[2005]] book ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld|Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''.<ref name="l3" /> Donal's entry on ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' refers to Solace speculating that Donal was a double agent, and being the reason the place of Solace was destroyed, however, this information is inaccurate,<ref name="TCCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and does not reflect ''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo|Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]'', where Solace speculates that it is another one of her assistants, [[Duro (individual)|Duro]], who was the reason that the place of Solace was destroyed, with Oryon confirming it, having seen Duro escape on a speeder.<ref name="l4" />
